rule.name: UAM_qry_practiceQuestionsSet4TdateAndTime
rule.description: Date and Time problems are here
rule.definition: a!localVariables( /* 61. An employee joined on date(2020, 3, 15) and today is date(2024, 3, 15). Write an expression to calculate how many complete years they've been employed. */ local!joiningdate:date(2020,3,15), local!today:date(2024,3,15), local!completedyears:abs(year(local!today)-year(local!joiningdate)), /* 62. A project has startDate = date(2024, 1, 15) and endDate = date(2024, 3, 30). Write an expression to calculate the project duration in days. */ local!startdate:date(2024,1,15), local!enddate:date(2024,3,30), local!duration:local!enddate-local!startdate, /* 63. Today is date(2024, 6, 15). Write an expression to get the first day of the current month. */ local!givendate:date(2024,6,15), local!currentday:todate(date(year(local!givendate),month(local!givendate),1)), /* 64. A subscription started on date(2023, 6, 1) with a duration of 18 months. Write an expression to calculate the expiry date. */ local!subscriptionstart:date(2023,6,1), local!expirydate:todate(edate(local!subscriptionstart,18)), /* 65. Two timestamps: meeting1 = datetime(2024, 6, 15, 14, 30, 0) and meeting2 = datetime(2024, 6, 15, 16, 0, 0). Write an expression to calculate the time difference in hours. */ local!meeting1:datetime(2024, 6, 15, 14, 30, 0), local!meeting2:datetime(2024,6, 15, 16, 0, 0), local!time1:hour(local!meeting1) + minute(local!meeting1)/60 + second(local!meeting1)/3600, local!time2:hour(local!meeting2) + minute(local!meeting2)/60 + second(local!meeting2)/3600, local!timedifference:(local!time2-local!time1)*60, /* 66. A deadline is date(2024, 12, 25). Write an expression to determine if it falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday). */ local!deadline:date(2024,12,25), local!day:weekday(local!deadline), local!weekend:if(or((local!day==1),local!day==7),"Weekend","weekday"), /* 67. An invoice date is date(2024, 6, 1) with payment terms of "Net 30". Write an expression to calculate the due date (30 days after invoice date). */ local!invoicedate:date(2024,6,1), local!duedate:todate(local!invoicedate+30), /* 68. Today is date(2024, 6, 15). Write an expression to get the date of the last day of the previous month. */ local!dates:date(2024,6,15), local!endmonth:todate(eomonth(local!dates,-1)), /* 69. A person's birthdate is date(1990, 5, 20) and today is date(2024, 6, 15). Write an expression to calculate their age in years. */ local!birthdate:date(1990,5,20), local!todaydate:date(2024,6,15), local!calculate:year(local!todaydate)-year(local!birthdate), /* 70. A task was created at datetime(2024, 6, 15, 9, 30, 0) and completed at datetime(2024, 6, 15, 14, 45, 0). Write an expression to calculate the time taken in minutes. */ local!datetime:datetime(2024, 6, 15, 9, 30, 0), local!datetime1:datetime(2024, 6, 15,14, 45, 0), local!hour:hour(local!datetime)*60 + minute(local!datetime), local!hour1:hour(local!datetime1)*60 + minute(local!datetime1), local!totalhour:local!hour1-local!hour, /* 71. A fiscal year starts on April 1st. Today is date(2024, 6, 15). Write an expression to determine the current fiscal year (e.g., "FY2024-2025"). */ local!fiscalyear:date(2024,6,15), local!currentfiscalyear:if( month(local!fiscalyear)>=4, concat("FY",year(local!fiscalyear),"-",year(local!fiscalyear)+1), concat("FY",year(local!fiscalyear)-1,"-",year(local!fiscalyear)) ), /* 72. A contract is valid for 90 days starting from date(2024, 1, 1). Write an expression to check if today date(2024, 2, 15) is still within the valid period. */ local!contract:date(2024,1,1), local!isdate:todate(local!contract+90), local!checkdate:date(2024,2,15), local!checking:if(local!checkdate<=local!isdate,"valid period","is not valid period"), /* 73. Today is date(2024, 6, 15). Write an expression to get the date 3 months from now */ local!express:date(2024,6,15), local!emonth:todate(edate(local!express,3)), /* 74. A shift starts at time(9, 0, 0) and ends at time(17, 30, 0). Write an expression to calculate shift duration in hours and minutes (e.g., "8.5 hours"). */ local!shiftstart:time(9, 0, 0), local!shiftclosing:time(17, 30, 0), local!onlyhour:hour(local!shiftstart)*60 + minute(local!shiftstart), local!onlyhour1:hour(local!shiftclosing)*60 + minute(local!shiftclosing), local!onlyhours:(local!onlyhour1-local!onlyhour)/60, /* 75. An event is scheduled for date(2024, 12, 25). Write an expression to calculate how many days remain until the event from today date(2024, 6, 15). */ local!event:date(2024,12,25), local!todayevent:date(2024,6,15), local!difference:local!event-local!todayevent, /* 76. A report covers from date(2024, 1, 1) to date(2024, 3, 31). Write an expression to generate a label "Q1 2024" based on these dates */ local!reportcover:date(2024,1,1), local!todate:date(2024,3,31), local!label:tointeger((month(local!reportcover)+2)/3), local!labelling:concat("Q", local!label," ", year(local!reportcover)), /* 77. A reminder should be sent 7 days before an event on date(2024, 7, 1). Write an expression to calculate the reminder date. */ local!sent:todate(date(2024,7,1)-7), /* 8. Two dates: startDate = date(2024, 1, 15) and endDate = date(2024, 2, 10). Write an expression to check if they are in the same month.*/ local!startdates:date(2024,1,15), local!enddates:date(2024,2,10), local!startmonth:month(local!startdates), local!endmonths:month(local!enddates), local!month1:if(local!startmonth==local!endmonths,true(),false()), /* Q79. Today is date(2024, 6, 15). Write an expression to determine if it's the last day of the month.*/ local!determined:date(2024,6,15), local!determined1:eomonth(local!determined,0), local!last:if(local!determined==local!determined1,true(),false()), /* 80. A project deadline is datetime(2024, 6, 30, 17, 0, 0). Write an expression to format it as "June 30, 2024 at 5:00 PM". */ local!project: datetime(2024, 6, 30, 17, 0, 0), local!month: text(local!project, "MMMM"), local!day1: day(local!project), local!year1: year(local!project), local!hour22: hour(local!project), local!minute: text(minute(local!project), "00"), local!ampm: if(local!hour22 >= 12, "PM", "AM"), local!displayHour: if(local!hour22 > 12, local!hour22 - 12, local!hour22), local!days: concat(local!month, " ", local!day1, ", ", local!year1, " at ", local!displayHour, ":", local!minute, " ", local!ampm), { local!completedyears, local!duration, local!currentday, local!expirydate, local!timedifference, local!weekend, local!duedate, local!endmonth, local!calculate, local!totalhour, local!currentfiscalyear, local!isdate, local!checking, local!emonth, local!onlyhours, local!difference, local!labelling, local!sent, local!month1, local!determined1, local!last, local!days } )
